mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL growth > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals increased economic activity and supply-side strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO growth > 2% does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and simultaneously the Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a labor market recovery, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS growth > 200,000 does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past 3 months signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decrease > 10% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% annualized, it signals a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL growth > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) over the past 6 months signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or GDPC1 growth does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).
